# Maintenance

The limiting resource is often authority rather than a spare part. A key register, a full cupboard and a detailed procedure can coexist with a queue waiting for one person to say yes. Draw the route of the decision separately from the route of the work. If both end at the same person, a new rota may not reduce dependence.

A handover should transfer the ability to decide, including the ability to refuse an unsafe repair or stop an interrupted shift. Add an owner, an alternative and a review date to recurring responsibilities. [[Volunteer handbook]] is one test of whether the fallback is usable by someone who did not design it. Keep temporary offers temporary. Reliability cannot mean requiring a particular volunteer to be present forever.
